Filing gate: ① a checklist assertion fix. One clause of a platform-checklist item asserts a UI shape that a later, deliberate change removed, so the clause fails while the product works as designed. This is the "stale spec" disposition of `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §5, from QA run #27438 (wave 3 of the 18.3.0 sweep, anchor #27377). reach: a red row on the release record; every Tier 1 rerun re-fails it until the clause is re-pointed.
Business reason: a red row that is not a product bug costs every sweep a re-diagnosis and hides real reds in the same item. The clause, its steps and its pin spec all still look for a History tab.
Reader who acts: the lane that owns `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). The edit goes to `areas/records-forms.json`, and `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` also needs updating or retiring.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "field-history-tracking History tab record page v3 checklist re-point" → 2 hits — #25846 (closed, the 18.2.0 records-forms ledger batch) and #27312 (open: the SPEC describe() of `enable.trackHistory` still narrates the v2 History tab) — related, but neither re-points this checklist clause.

Batch-of: 16 · QA run #27438

## What is stale

`records-forms.field-history-tracking` (revision 9):
- acceptance[2]: "the History TAB gates on OBJECT-level `enable.trackHistory` … the account detail renders the tab";
- negative[1] and steps[3], which say the same;
- `automated.ref`, which says `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` holds the flag-true half.

## Measured at c4c515ad (2 fresh loads plus the live spec)

1. As admin at 1440×900, open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_account/record/ID`.
2. There is no tab strip at all (`role=tab` count 0). Field changes appear under **Timeline › Changes**.
3. The page reads `sys_audit_log`. The task detail page (tracking off) makes no audit-log read.
4. `record-history-display.spec.ts` fails with a 15 s timeout on `getByRole('tab', {name: 'History'})`.

The cause is deliberate: record page v3 (eef83734, #27055, with the stream from #27310) removed the History and Activity tabs, and its own unit test asserts "no Activity or History tab". The gate the clause exists for still holds: tracked objects read the audit log, untracked ones do not.

## What it should say

Re-point acceptance[2], negative[1] and steps[3] to the v3 surface:
- on a `trackHistory` object, the Timeline's **Changes** stream lists the tracked field changes and the page reads `sys_audit_log`;
- on an object without it, no Changes entries appear and no audit-log read is made.

Update or retire the live spec to match. Separately, negative[3] is a cross-reference guard ("do NOT re-score crud-roundtrip clause 5"), not an assertion, so it can only ever score `skipped`. Move it out of `negative[]`.
